page.title: soで内容を受け、省略で流れを速く

analysis.summaryJa: soは既出の状態・程度・命題を短く受け、think／hope／ifと組み合わせる。省略ではcan・have・beなど復元の支柱を残し、重複する動詞句だけを消すページである。
grammarPoints: soは既出の形容詞・状態・程度・命題全体を代用できる
if soは肯定命題を条件として、if notはその否定を条件として受ける
think／believe／say／hope＋soは肯定内容を、hope not・think notは否定内容を受ける
more so・even more soは前の形容詞や程度を受け、程度がさらに強いことを示す
visualEvidence: SOの結晶が形容詞・程度・文全体を一つの小さな指示物として受け止める上段の図
think so・hope so・if soと、hope not・think notを対比した内容代用カード
反復する列車の車両が消え、can・has・isなどの支柱だけが残る省略図
形容詞、程度、命題という異なる代用対象からSOへ集まる矢印
commonTraps: if soのsoを接続詞のように誤解して後ろにitを重ねる
canで問われた短答にdoを、現在完了で問われた短答にdoesを使う
be動詞の状態をdoesで受けるなど、残す文法支柱を取り違える
hope notとdon't hope so、think notとdon't think soの形やニュアンスを混同する

questions.prompt: The shipment may arrive before noon. If -------, the receiving team will unload it immediately.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 荷物は正午前に到着するかもしれません。そうであれば、受入チームがすぐに荷下ろしします。
questions.explanationJa: soは前文の命題the shipment may arrive before noon全体を受け、if soで『もしそうなら』を表します。

questions.prompt: “Will the client approve the revised layout?” “I certainly hope -------.”

choices.A: so

questions.translationJa: 「顧客は改訂レイアウトを承認するでしょうか」「ぜひそうなることを願っています」
questions.explanationJa: hope soは直前の肯定命題the client will approve the layoutを短く受ける定型表現です。
questions.focus: hope soで肯定内容を受ける

questions.prompt: The lobby looked crowded yesterday, and it appears even more ------- this morning.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: ロビーは昨日混雑して見えましたが、今朝はさらにそう見えます。
questions.explanationJa: more soは前の形容詞crowdedを受け、『さらにその程度が強い』と表します。
questions.focus: more soによる形容詞・程度の代用

questions.prompt: “Is the replacement part available locally?” “The supplier says -------.”

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 「交換部品は地元で入手できますか」「仕入先はそうだと言っています」
questions.explanationJa: says soのsoがthe part is available locallyという文内容を受けています。

questions.prompt: The director expects sales to recover next quarter, but several analysts think -------.

choices.A: not

questions.translationJa: 役員は来四半期に売上が回復すると予想していますが、複数の分析担当者はそうは思っていません。
questions.explanationJa: think notは直前の肯定命題を否定して受け、『そうではないと思う』を簡潔に表します。
questions.focus: think notによる否定命題の代用

questions.prompt: The old entrance is difficult to find, and the temporary one is even more -------.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 旧入口は見つけにくく、仮設入口はさらに見つけにくいです。
questions.explanationJa: even more soが形容詞句difficult to findを受け、程度の増加を示します。
questions.focus: even more soで形容詞句を受ける

questions.prompt: “Can anyone update the reservation list today?” “Ms. Green -------.”

choices.A: does

questions.translationJa: 「今日、予約者一覧を更新できる人はいますか」「グリーンさんならできます」
questions.explanationJa: modal canを残し、update the reservation list todayという復元可能な動詞句を省略しています。

questions.prompt: The research team has completed its survey, and the marketing team ------- too.

choices.A: does

questions.translationJa: 調査チームはアンケートを完了し、マーケティングチームも完了しています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了has completed its surveyの重複部分を省き、単数主語に合うhasを文法的支柱として残します。

questions.prompt: The waiting area is usually quiet, but it was not ------- during yesterday's event.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 待合エリアは普段静かですが、昨日の催しではそうではありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not soのsoが形容詞quietを受け、過去の状態が普段と違ったことを表します。
questions.focus: be soで形容詞状態を受ける

questions.prompt: “Will the road closure delay our delivery?” “I hope -------, but we have added extra travel time.”

choices.A: not

questions.translationJa: 「通行止めで配送が遅れますか」「そうならないことを願いますが、移動時間には余裕を加えました」
questions.explanationJa: hope notはthe road closure will delay our deliveryという望ましくない命題を否定して受けます。
questions.focus: hope notで否定内容を受ける

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a possible schedule change.

choices.A: The inspection may finish early. If one, we will reopen the area at three.
choices.B: The inspection may finish early. If so, we will reopen the area at three.
choices.C: The inspection may finish early. If does, we will reopen the area at three.
choices.D: The inspection may finish early. If so it, we will reopen the area at three.

questions.translationJa: 点検は早く終わるかもしれません。そうなら、3時にその区域を再開します。
questions.explanationJa: 前文の可能性全体をif soで受けた文だけが正しく、soの後ろに不要なitは置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct response to a question about a delivery.

choices.A: “Has the courier collected the parcel?” “Yes, she does.”
choices.B: “Has the courier collected the parcel?” “Yes, she is.”
choices.C: “Has the courier collected the parcel?” “Yes, she so.”
choices.D: “Has the courier collected the parcel?” “Yes, she has.”

questions.translationJa: 「配達員は荷物を集荷しましたか」「はい、しました」
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了の質問にはhasを残して答え、collected the parcelは明白なので省略できます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing stronger concern.

choices.A: The first estimate was concerning, and the revised one was even more so.
choices.B: The first estimate was concerning, and the revised one was even more one.
choices.C: The first estimate was concerning, and the revised one did even more.
choices.D: The first estimate was concerning, and the revised one was even so more it.

questions.translationJa: 最初の見積もりも懸念すべきものでしたが、改訂版はさらに懸念すべきものでした。
questions.explanationJa: even more soが形容詞concerningを受け、改訂版ではその程度がさらに強いと示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about two employees' availability.

choices.A: Ravi is available this afternoon, and Elena does too.
choices.B: Ravi is available this afternoon, and Elena has too.
choices.C: Ravi is available this afternoon, and Elena is too.
choices.D: Ravi is available this afternoon, and Elena so too.

questions.translationJa: ラビは今日の午後に対応可能で、エレナも対応可能です。
questions.explanationJa: be動詞の状態is availableを受けるため、Elena is tooとbe動詞を支柱として残します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a hoped-for outcome.

choices.A: The permit may be issued tomorrow, and we hope one.
choices.B: The permit may be issued tomorrow, and we hope does.
choices.C: The permit may be issued tomorrow, and we hope it so is.
choices.D: The permit may be issued tomorrow, and we hope so.

questions.translationJa: 許可証は明日発行されるかもしれず、私たちはそうなることを願っています。
questions.explanationJa: hope soがthe permit may be issued tomorrowという肯定命題全体を自然に受けています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct short response about finishing a report.

choices.A: “Can you finish the report by noon?” “Yes, I do.”
choices.B: “Can you finish the report by noon?” “Yes, I can.”
choices.C: “Can you finish the report by noon?” “Yes, I am.”
choices.D: “Can you finish the report by noon?” “Yes, I so.”

questions.translationJa: 「正午までに報告書を仕上げられますか」「はい、できます」
questions.explanationJa: canで問われた能力・可能性にはcanを残し、finish the report by noonを省略して答えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a completed training requirement.

choices.A: I have completed the safety module, and all new employees do as well.
choices.B: I have completed the safety module, and all new employees are as well.
choices.C: I have completed the safety module, and all new employees have as well.
choices.D: I have completed the safety module, and all new employees so have it.

questions.translationJa: 私は安全講習を修了しており、新入社員全員も修了しています。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了have completedを受けるため、複数主語all new employeesの後ろにhaveを残します。
questions.focus: have as wellによる完了形省略

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a negative expectation.

choices.A: The flight could be canceled, but the agent thinks not.
choices.B: The flight could be canceled, but the agent thinks one.
choices.C: The flight could be canceled, but the agent thinks does.
choices.D: The flight could be canceled, but the agent not thinks so it.

questions.translationJa: その便は欠航になる可能性がありますが、係員はそうではないと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: thinks notはthe flight could be canceledという命題を否定して受ける、簡潔でやや改まった形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a repeated state.

choices.A: The server is stable now and should remain one overnight.
choices.B: The server is stable now and should remain does overnight.
choices.C: The server is stable now and should so remain it overnight.
choices.D: The server is stable now and should remain so overnight.

questions.translationJa: サーバーは現在安定しており、夜間もその状態を保つはずです。
questions.explanationJa: remain soのsoが形容詞stableを受け、同じ状態が続くことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a document that may be unnecessary.

choices.A: We may need an additional form; if one, the current application is complete.
choices.B: We may need an additional form; if not, the current application is complete.
choices.C: We may need an additional form; if does, the current application is complete.
choices.D: We may need an additional form; if not it, the current application is complete.

questions.translationJa: 追加書類が必要かもしれません。必要でなければ、現在の申請書類で完備しています。
questions.explanationJa: if notは前の命題we need an additional formを否定して受け、『そうでなければ』を表します。
questions.focus: if notによる否定命題の省略

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The store may extend its hours. If it does, we will update the website."

choices.A: The store will update its hours only on the website.
choices.B: The website will remain unchanged even if the hours are extended.
choices.C: The store has decided not to extend its hours.
choices.D: The store may extend its hours. If so, we will update the website.

questions.translationJa: 店舗は営業時間を延長するかもしれません。そうなれば、ウェブサイトを更新します。
questions.explanationJa: if soはif the store extends its hoursという命題を受け、元文と同じ条件関係を保ちます。
questions.focus: if it doesとif soの言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I believe that the new policy will reduce delays."

choices.A: I believe the policy will increase delays.
choices.C: I do not know which policy is new.
choices.D: I believe only the delay figures.

questions.translationJa: 私はそうなると考えています。
questions.explanationJa: 直前に共有された命題を前提にした場合、believe soはthat節全体を代用して同じ肯定判断を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Nadia has submitted the form, and Omar has submitted it too."

choices.A: Nadia submitted Omar's form instead of her own.
choices.B: Omar has not yet received the form.
choices.C: Nadia has submitted the form, and Omar has too.
choices.D: Nadia and Omar submitted different forms for each other.

questions.translationJa: ナディアは書類を提出し、オマールも提出済みです。
questions.explanationJa: Omar has tooはOmar has submitted the form tooの復元可能な部分を省略した形です。
questions.focus: 現在完了の省略による言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The southern office is busy, and the northern office is even busier."

choices.A: The southern office is busy, and the northern office is even more so.
choices.B: Both offices have exactly the same workload.
choices.C: The southern office is busier than the northern office.

questions.translationJa: 南部オフィスは忙しく、北部オフィスはさらに忙しいです。
questions.explanationJa: even more soがbusyを受け、北部オフィスの忙しさがさらに強いという比較を維持します。
questions.focus: 比較級的なmore soの言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We hope that the weather will not disrupt the outdoor reception."

choices.A: We expect the reception to be canceled by the weather.
choices.C: We hope the reception will be held indoors.
choices.D: We have no opinion about the weather.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはそうならないことを願っています。
questions.explanationJa: 会話上the weather will disrupt the receptionが提示済みなら、hope notがその否定を同じ意味で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Lena can operate the new terminal, and Marco can operate it as well."

choices.A: Lena operates the terminal for Marco.
choices.B: Marco cannot use the terminal without Lena.
choices.C: Only Lena has permission to operate the terminal.
choices.D: Lena can operate the new terminal, and Marco can as well.

questions.translationJa: レナは新端末を操作でき、マルコも操作できます。
questions.explanationJa: Marco can as wellはcan operate the new terminal as wellから復元可能な動詞句を省略した形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The conference room is vacant, and the training room is vacant too."

choices.A: The conference room is vacant, and the training room is too.
choices.B: The training room is occupied by the conference staff.
choices.C: Only the conference room is vacant.
choices.D: Both rooms will become unavailable shortly.

questions.translationJa: 会議室は空いており、研修室も空いています。
questions.explanationJa: the training room is tooはis vacant tooを省略した形で、be動詞を残して同じ状態を表します。
questions.focus: be動詞を残す状態の省略

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The consultant says that the revised forecast is realistic."

choices.A: The consultant has not seen the revised forecast.
choices.B: The consultant says the original forecast was more realistic.
choices.D: The revised forecast was prepared by the consultant alone.

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントはそうだと言っています。
questions.explanationJa: 共有済みのthe revised forecast is realisticをsoで受けると、says soは元のthat節と同じ内容を伝えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The display was attractive last year and continues to be attractive."

choices.A: The display was attractive last year and continues to be so.
choices.B: The display is no longer attractive.
choices.C: The display became attractive only this year.
choices.D: Last year's display has been removed.

questions.translationJa: その展示は昨年魅力的で、今もその状態が続いています。
questions.explanationJa: be soのsoがattractiveを受け、状態が継続していることを元文どおり表します。
questions.focus: be soによる形容詞補語の代用

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The invoice might be incorrect, although I do not think that it is."

choices.A: I am certain that the invoice is incorrect.
choices.B: I have not looked at the invoice at all.
choices.C: The invoice was corrected before I received it.
choices.D: The invoice might be incorrect, although I think not.

questions.translationJa: 請求書が誤っている可能性はありますが、私はそうではないと思います。
questions.explanationJa: think notがthe invoice is incorrectという命題を否定して受け、元文の判断を簡潔に保ちます。
questions.focus: 否定内容をthink notで言い換える

questions.prompt: The manufacturer may issue a software patch tonight. If -------, our technicians will install it before opening time.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 製造元は今夜ソフトウェア修正を公開するかもしれません。そうなれば、技術者が開店前に導入します。
questions.explanationJa: if soが前文の可能性全体を受け、後続する対応の条件を示します。

questions.prompt: “Has the accounting office confirmed the transfer?” “Yes, it -------.”

choices.A: does

questions.translationJa: 「経理部は振込を確認しましたか」「はい、確認しました」
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了has confirmedで問われているため、短い肯定応答でもhasを文法的支柱として残します。

questions.prompt: The first complaint was serious. The second was even more ------- because it involved a safety issue.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 最初の苦情は深刻でした。2件目は安全上の問題を含んでいたため、さらに深刻でした。
questions.explanationJa: more soが形容詞seriousを受け、理由節が程度の強まりを支えています。

questions.prompt: The board believes the merger will be completed this month. Most investors think ------- as well.

choices.A: so

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は合併が今月完了すると考えています。大半の投資家もそう考えています。
questions.explanationJa: think soがthe merger will be completed this monthという肯定命題全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: The outdoor ceremony could be moved indoors. We hope -------, since the garden has already been prepared.

choices.A: so

questions.translationJa: 屋外式典は屋内へ移される可能性があります。庭園の準備が済んでいるため、そうならないことを願っています。
questions.explanationJa: 望ましくない命題the ceremony could be moved indoorsを否定して受けるのでhope notです。
questions.focus: 理由文脈から選ぶhope not

questions.prompt: Priya will attend the supplier meeting. Her department manager will ------- too.

choices.A: be

questions.translationJa: プリヤは仕入先会議に出席します。彼女の部門長も出席します。
questions.explanationJa: 空所の後にtooしかなく、willはすでに置かれていません。
questions.focus: 省略可能な支柱の有無

questions.prompt: Our east branch is open on national holidays. The west branch ------- too.

choices.A: is

questions.translationJa: 東支店は祝日も営業しています。西支店も営業しています。
questions.explanationJa: openは形容詞で、前文のis openを受けるためbe動詞isを残します。
questions.focus: 形容詞補語を受けるbe省略

questions.prompt: The client may request another demonstration. If -------, reserve the larger presentation room.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 顧客がもう一度実演を求めるかもしれません。そうなら、大きいプレゼン室を予約してください。
questions.explanationJa: if soがthe client requests another demonstrationという命題を受け、命令文の条件を作ります。

questions.prompt: The new packaging is recyclable and will remain ------- after the protective coating is added.

choices.A: one

questions.translationJa: 新しい包装はリサイクル可能で、保護コーティングを加えた後もその状態を保ちます。
questions.explanationJa: remain soのsoが形容詞recyclableを受け、加工後も同じ性質が続くことを示します。

questions.prompt: “Will the venue waive the cancellation fee?” “I don't think -------, but I will ask the manager.”

choices.A: not

questions.translationJa: 「会場はキャンセル料を免除しますか」「そうは思いませんが、責任者に確認します」
questions.explanationJa: don't think soは肯定命題the venue will waive the feeを否定して受ける一般的な形です。
